'''Morgotou''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] working with the [[Kessel Spice Corporation]].

==Biography==
Morgotou was invited by [[Sard Nightbringer]] to an auction on the ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]''. On his way there, his ship, ''[[Platinum Mist]]'', was attacked and destroyed by [[Pari' Notgoth]]. Morgotou was able to get away in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] but [[Death/Legends|died]] when the pod was also attacked. His corpse was discovered by a group of spacers who were also heading to the auction and used his invitation to join the proceedings.<ref name="AB" />
